importFolder.title: Import a folder
importFolder.intro: Links the music you have already downloaded to the library. Each file is looked up on YouTube Music by the artist, album, title and duration in its tags, and anything missing is imported. Files that do not match with confidence are listed below and left alone. Files are never moved or changed.
importFolder.hint: Path inside the downloads folder, for example “Artist/Album”. Leave it empty to walk the whole folder.
importFolder.result: {linked} linked, {already} were already linked and {unlinked} not linked.

reason.outside: Link to a file outside the downloads folder
reason.not_found: No confident match on YouTube Music
reason.already_downloaded: Track already downloaded in another file
reason.ambiguous: On several albums and the file does not say which
